title: BridgeProof v1
description: Typed primitive for equivalence claims between two representations. Implements NO EQUIVALENCE WITHOUT A BRIDGE PROOF: A ≡ B iff Bridge(A,B)=WITNESSED. Four independent axes: relation (ontological claim), comparability (whether comparison is meaningful), verification_state (witness result), probe_state (probe procedural health). Each axis must be emitted separately. EQUIVALENT_TO requires COMPARABLE ∧ WITNESSED ∧ non-empty evidence_refs. TYPE_MISMATCH is NOT divergence. ProbeFailure is NOT relation REFUTED. Compatible(A,B) = SameType(A,B) OR WitnessedBridge(A,B).

relation.description: Ontological relation under test. NEVER carries TYPE_MISMATCH or UNDETERMINED — those belong to comparability.

comparability.description: Whether the two representations can be compared on the same axis. COMPARABLE = same type OR WitnessedBridge exists. TYPE_MISMATCH = types differ and no bridge. INCOMMENSURABLE = no known bridge can map them. UNMEASURED = probe has not run. INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE = probe ran but evidence insufficient.

verification_state.description: What the witness actually concluded. WITNESSED = evidence supports relation. REFUTED = evidence contradicts relation. UNRESOLVED = insufficient evidence either way.

probe_state.description: Procedural health of the measurement. ERROR/UNREACHABLE/NOT_RUN must NEVER auto-promote to REFUTED — probe failure is not refutation.

type_mismatch_resolution.description: If types differ, attempt normalization through known scheme bridges (e.g. pep440_to_git_sha_via_BUILDINFO). Null if no bridge attempted.

bridge_artifact_ref.description: Artifact backing the bridge (BUILDINFO, SBOM, wheel metadata, etc.)

witness_evidence_refs.description: Raw evidence backing the witness. Empty array forces verification_state=UNRESOLVED.

applied_to.description: Where this BridgeProof has been applied (RuntimePacket drift fields, CapabilityGraph callable set, worldline epsilon, etc.)

supersedes.description: Prior BridgeProof id, if this updates a previous one.

allOf.description: HARD INVARIANT 1: EQUIVALENT_TO requires COMPARABLE ∧ WITNESSED ∧ non-empty evidence.
HARD INVARIANT 2: Probe failure cannot masquerade as REFUTED.

verification_state.description: If probe_state ∈ {ERROR, UNREACHABLE, NOT_RUN}, verification_state MUST be UNRESOLVED. REFUTED is forbidden because no measurement happened.

allOf.description: HARD INVARIANT 3: Empty witness_evidence_refs forces UNRESOLVED.
